sloka: तपनीय गवाक्षाणि मुक्ता जाल आवृतानि च ।हैम राजत भौमानि वैदूर्य मणिमन्ति च ॥४-५०-३१॥
transliteration: tapanīya gavākṣāṇi muktā jāla āvṛtāni ca ।haima rājata bhaumāni vaidūrya maṇimanti ca ॥4-50-31॥

translations.english: The vanaras beheld highrise palaces built with gold and silver. The windows fixed on the roof were golden, shaped like cow's eye with lattices of pearls. They also saw best of houses built in gold, silver and clay, decorated with precious gems including vaidurya.
